messages:
Samir (partnerships): Zenith just sent a spreadsheet with revised reserved commit bands and spot discounts for Q3–Q4. Need canonical numbers to plug into the cost model. Key asks: min commit term, standard spot discount, expected eviction rate (per region & GPU family). Link: s3://redwood/partners/zenith/zenith_pricing_q3.csv

Jessica (finance): what's the runway on committing? need revenue delta for 12/36 month options. can we get blended unit cost vs on-demand?

Omar (cloud-ops): region variance: ap-south spot seems much higher evictions. can Zenith provide historical eviction % or preemption distribution? call out GPU families (A100 / H100)

Laura (product): for latency-sensitive tiers we should keep a low-latency reserved bucket distinct from high-throughput reserved. Also add batch throughput tiers (50, 200, 1000 tokens/s).

Corey (procurement-bot): Contract draft uploaded: /contracts/zenith-draft-2026-03.pdf. Summarized key points: 6mo min commit, 3-tier pricing bands, early termination = 30% of remaining commit. :page_facing_up:

Samir (partnerships): perfect — for modeling I only need three numbers per region/GPU family: min_commit_months, avg_spot_discount_pct, expected_eviction_rate_pct. Please drop them on the 'model_inputs' tab in the spreadsheet or paste as rows below. Will run a 3x3 scenario matrix by EOW. @Jessica can you add 12/24/36 revenue delta columns?

Jessica (finance): will add 12/24/36 columns in ~1h. FYI I'm assuming 70% utilization baseline unless ops advise otherwise.

Omar (cloud-ops): adding historical eviction samples now from monitoring. sample rows:
```
region,gpu_family,timestamp,eviction_rate_pct
us-west-2,A100,2025-11-01,2.4
us-west-2,H100,2025-11-01,5.1
ap-south-1,A100,2025-11-01,12.8
```

Laura (product): also note marketplace listing fee is negotiated as 1.5% rebate on usage for first 12 months — include as a line item in unit economics.

Samir (partnerships): action items: 1) Omar paste historical eviction numbers into model_inputs; 2) Jessica add revenue delta columns + utilization assumptions; 3) Corey confirm min_commit_months in contract (procurement). Deadline: Friday EOD. I'll run scenarios and share a brief deck. :rocket:

Jessica (finance): acked. :thumbsup:

Corey (procurement-bot): noted. I'll follow up with legal re: early termination language.

Samir (partnerships): thanks team — ping here if anything changes.
